en.headline: Jobless rate rises to 3.8pc in June-August period
en.dek: Seasonally adjusted unemployment edged up 0.1 percentage point from the previous three months, while underemployment climbed to 1.9 per cent, Census and Statistics Department figures show.
body: Hong Kong’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 3.8 per cent in the three months to August, up from 3.7 per cent in May to July, the Census and Statistics Department said on Thursday.

The underemployment rate also increased, from 1.7 per cent to 1.9 per cent over the same periods. On a non-seasonally adjusted basis, the number of unemployed persons rose by about 8,200 to 153,900, while underemployed persons increased by around 5,900 to 72,100.

Total employment grew by about 4,400 to 3.652 million and the labour force expanded by roughly 12,600 to 3.806 million. Unemployment rose across most major sectors, with a more noticeable increase in food and beverage service activities. Underemployment increases were concentrated in food and beverage services and construction.

Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the continued expansion of the local economy is expected to support overall labour-market conditions, though employment in individual industries will still depend on their own business environments. He noted that the potential impact of external uncertainties on hiring intentions remains a point to watch.

zh.headline: 六月至八月失業率升至3.8% 就業不足率1.9%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率較前三個月上升0.1個百分點，就業不足率亦升至1.9%，統計處公布最新勞動人口數字。
body: 政府統計處周四公布，經季節性調整的失業率由五至七月的3.7%上升至六月至八月的3.8%。就業不足率由1.7%升至1.9%。
不經季節性調整方面，失業人數增加約8,200人至153,900人，就業不足人數增加約5,900人至72,100人。同期總就業人數增加約4,400人至365.2萬人，勞動人口增加約12,600人至380.6萬人。
大多數主要經濟行業的失業率均有上升，當中餐飲服務活動業升幅較為明顯。就業不足率上升主要見於餐飲服務活動業及建造業。
勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，本地經濟繼續擴張預計會為整體勞工市場提供支持，惟各行業就業情況仍取決於自身經營環境。外圍不確定因素對企業招聘意欲的潛在影響，仍值得關注。
